verdict.rationale: Canny documents tying feedback to identified user accounts via its SDK. Through its MCP server, it also lets PMs understand the context behind each request, see ARR impact across ideas, and link deals, which directly supports prioritizing by customer value. missing for 10: in-depth docs on the in-app display of customer/company attributes next to feedback (Companies and Custom Fields pages appear only as titles), explicit prioritization or segmentation workflows beyond the MCP/LLM interface, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can access customer context alongside feedback so I prioritize what really matters

citations.quote: when they leave feedback on Canny, it'll be tied to their existing user account in your application
Ask your LLM what customers asked for and understand the context behind each request. Dig into top themes, ARR impact across ideas
Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
